name: pushery/wirekit
description: A free, open-source UI component library for Laravel Livewire — styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and powered by Alpine.js.

suggest.blade-ui-kit/blade-icons: Required for the icon system (~1.7). Install alongside your preferred icon set.
suggest.blade-ui-kit/blade-heroicons: Heroicons preset — one glyph catalog in mini, outline, solid and micro styles
suggest.mallardduck/blade-lucide-icons: Lucide preset — outline glyphs, plus a separate lab catalog
suggest.codeat3/blade-phosphor-icons: Phosphor preset — one glyph catalog in six weight styles
suggest.secondnetwork/blade-tabler-icons: Tabler preset — outline and filled glyphs in the one catalog
suggest.bacon/bacon-qr-code: Required for the qr-code component — server-side QR code SVG generation
